dailyReview.headline: AI shorts under pressure as Meta-CoreWeave and Firefly Assistant reshape narratives
dailyReview.summary: Portfolio is pushing against the tape on the AI short leg (NVDA, CRWV) but the long book — Adobe, Uber, commodities, and midstream energy — is hitting on multiple catalysts today. Net cash + gold/silver + oil names are providing ballast into a week marked by Middle East risk, record metals, and a fresh leg of AI capex headlines.
risks: NVDA on a 10-day, +18% win streak; short leg (-15.8%) plus long-dated puts (4.6%) is the largest concentrated risk in the book.
CoreWeave's $21B Meta deal + $6B Jane Street contract is pushing CRWV higher — both the short (-15.5%) and puts (1.4%) are fighting a momentum tape.
Brent ~$97 with a forecast peak of $115/b in Q2 helps the energy longs (RIG, CNE, USO, OKE, ET) but amplifies macro inflation risk.
bright_spots: Adobe +3.5% on Firefly AI Assistant launch (Apr 15) — largest long position (18%) catching a real product bid after a rough YTD.
Uber +6% on the week after a $10B AV commitment and Lucid/Pony AI/Rivian partnerships — validates the long thesis at 12.5%.
Gold at $4,781/oz and silver at $79.60/oz both near records; SLV +143% YoY — the metals sleeve is doing its hedging job.
Oil near $95 WTI on Iran negotiation doubts — directly supports RIG, CNE, USO and indirectly OKE/ET via midstream volumes.
actions_to_consider: Re-evaluate short sizing on NVDA/CRWV ahead of NVDA's Q1 FY27 print (guided $78B revenue ±2%). The puts provide convexity if the thesis plays out on a delayed timeline.
Altria ex-dividend date passed (record Mar 25); $1.06/share payable Apr 30 — confirm the position is held for the payout.
ONEOK prints Q1 on Apr 28 — consider whether to trim or add into the catalyst given +20% YTD run.

news.headline: Adobe unveils Firefly AI Assistant with Anthropic partnership; stock +3.5%
news.summary: Conversational creative-agent interface across Photoshop, Premiere, Lightroom, Illustrator. Now hosts 30+ third-party models including Google Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, ElevenLabs. Shares closed $243.96, still 42% below May 2025 highs.

news.headline: CoreWeave and Meta announce $21B expanded AI infrastructure agreement through 2032
news.summary: CRWV also signed a $6B Jane Street cloud deal plus $1B equity stake at $109/share. Revenue backlog now $66.8B, 4x a year ago. D.A. Davidson PT raised to $175.

news.headline: NVIDIA stock on 10-day winning streak, +18% over the stretch
news.summary: Data center revenue +75% YoY to $62.3B in Q4 FY26 (88% of total). Median analyst PT $265 implies ~50% upside. Q1 FY27 guide: $78B ±2%, no China data-center contribution assumed.

news.headline: Uber commits $10B to autonomous vehicles; +6% on the week
news.summary: $2.5B for AV-firm equity stakes + $7.5B for fleet expansion. New Lucid (35k vehicles), Pony AI (Europe robotaxi), Rivian, and Baidu partnerships. Citizens reiterated $100 PT. Plan: self-driving in 28 cities by 2028.

news.headline: WTI crude steady near $92; Brent $97 — EIA sees Q2 peak of $115/b
news.summary: Middle East disruptions + doubts on US-Iran talks lifted WTI as high as $95 intraday. Brent-WTI spread widened to $12. Forecast Brent peak $115/b in Q2 2026 before easing as shut-ins abate.

news.headline: Silver tops $79/oz, gold above $4,780 — safe-haven surge continues
news.summary: SLV trading at $74.97 (up from $71.24 prior close). Silver +143% YoY. Gold +$1,551 YoY on Islamabad peace talks and central-bank rate expectations.

news.headline: Micron surges 9% toward $500 on HBM4 volume production for NVIDIA Vera Rubin
news.summary: MU closed $465.66, +20% on the week. HBM4 36GB 12H memory gives 2.8 TB/s (2.3x HBM3E). 2026 HBM capacity fully sold under non-cancellable contracts. Median analyst PT $517.50.

news.headline: ONEOK and Energy Transfer flagged as top energy picks for April
news.summary: OKE +20% YTD with 4.7% yield and 3–4% annual dividend growth plan; Q1 earnings Apr 28. ET +15% YTD with ~7% distribution yield.

news.headline: Altria declares $1.06 quarterly dividend payable April 30
news.summary: Record date was March 25, 2026. Annual dividend $4.24, yield 6.54%. Q1 2026 earnings due ahead of the payment.

news.headline: Lululemon down 22.8% YTD, 34.7% over past year after soft FY26 guide
news.summary: Q4 GAAP EPS $5.01 beat $4.79 consensus but revenue softer; weaker FY26 guide. Texas PFAS investigation adds legal/reputational risk. 25-analyst average: Hold, 12-mo PT $190.26 (~+18%).

news.headline: Stride opens 2026-27 enrollment across OR, MI, ID, CO; LMS issues linger
news.summary: Multi-state virtual school enrollment now open for next school year. 2025 LMS upgrade disruption still weighing on fall-term revenue. Prior-year enrollment growth: General Ed +12.8%, Career Learning +32%.
